title: 1963 April Playboy Magazine Kellie Collins, Ian Fleming Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1963 April Playboy Magazine featuring Kellie Collins on the cover and Ian Fleming's complete article. This edition is a 1st edition and includes the centerfold. The magazine is published in English and is a monthly publication focusing on women, art & photography, celebrity, and men. It is an illustrated publication from the United States that covers topics such as photography, art, and modeling.
